title: console_login -- the person's own console login, placed by hand beside the safety policy (plan.md 15.1 item 4)
description: microscope_runtime/envelope/console_login.json, written BY THE PERSON, by hand, as safety.json is. The operator's approval reader compares a console-signed approval's signed_through.login to this login, byte for byte, and refuses on a mismatch, a missing file or an invalid one. It is never taken from the console's settings, which decide only the screen and which a session can write (15.1 item 4; manager-console-office-20261017-1's shape, 2026-10-22). Same pattern as plan_approval's signed_through.login: a plain id, never an email, because the file is committed. Nothing secret goes in, so the shape admits no other key.
